verified_facts.text: The hotel is in Killarney's town centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our location in Killarney’s town centre places you mere steps away from the very best that Kerry has to offer.

verified_facts.text: A two-minute walk from the hotel gate leads to the ancient oak forests of Killarney National Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just a two minute walk from the hotel gate brings you to its ancient oak forests and Ireland’s highest mountains

verified_facts.text: Killarney National Park is a 26,000-acre UNESCO biosphere reserve.
verified_facts.excerpt: Killarney National Park, is a 26,000-acre UNESCO biosphere reserve of pristine wilderness and breathtaking scenery.

verified_facts.text: Each suite has bespoke panoramic wallpapers created from historic watercolour paintings of Killarney National Park as it appeared two hundred years ago.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each suite tells its own story, through bespoke panoramic wallpapers created from historic watercolour paintings of Killarney National Park as it appeared two hundred years ago

verified_facts.text: Suites have handcrafted furnishings sourced from local artisans.
verified_facts.excerpt: handcrafted furnishings sourced from local artisans

verified_facts.text: The Garden Suites have private wraparound balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nature lovers gravitate to our Garden Suites, with their private wraparound balconies

verified_facts.text: One Bedroom Suites have separate living and sleeping areas.
verified_facts.excerpt: One Bedroom Suites, where separate living and sleeping areas offer an extra measure of comfort and privacy

verified_facts.text: Suites have an electric fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Electric Fireplace

verified_facts.text: Connecting rooms are available for groups travelling together.
verified_facts.excerpt: Groups travelling together appreciate the option for connecting rooms that offer a balance of togetherness and privacy.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have handmade furnishings and bespoke finishings.
verified_facts.excerpt: Handmade furnishings and bespoke finishings.

verified_facts.text: The Peregrine is the hotel's signature restaurant, offering relaxed contemporary fine dining.
verified_facts.excerpt: is our signature restaurant, offering relaxed contemporary fine dining paired with warm, approachable and elevated service.

verified_facts.text: The Peregrine is named after the National Park's most important protected bird species, the peregrine falcon.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Peregrine is named after the National Park’s most important, protected bird species.

verified_facts.text: Executive Head Chef Noel Enright and his team develop original dishes based on produce from local suppliers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Executive Head Chef Noel Enright and his team work passionately behind the scenes to develop original dishes based on the very best produce their local suppliers can offer from day to day.

verified_facts.text: The Peregrine's dinner menu evolves as the year turns.
verified_facts.excerpt: As the year turns, the dinner menu evolves.

verified_facts.text: The Peregrine was designed by Kim Partridge Interiors.
verified_facts.excerpt: The restaurant’s enchanting design, by the world-renowned Kim Partridge Interiors

verified_facts.text: The Peregrine has an oval cocktail bar, banquettes and horseshoe booths.
verified_facts.excerpt: The gentle curves of the oval cocktail bar and the restaurant’s elegant banquettes and atmospheric horseshoe booths create a sense of organic flow and movement.

verified_facts.text: The Peregrine's design uses hand-painted murals that echo the park's ancient forests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Earthy tones, hand-painted murals and soft fabrics echo the beauty of the park’s ancient forests

verified_facts.text: Afternoon Tea is served in The Peregrine on the first Sunday of each month.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the Killarney Park, Afternoon Tea is served on the first Sunday of each month, and reservations are highly encouraged.

verified_facts.text: There is a vegan and vegetarian Afternoon Tea menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: We have also created a vegan and vegetarian Afternoon Tea menu of plant-based delicacies.

verified_facts.text: The Garden Bar has the warmth and comfort of a traditional Irish pub.
verified_facts.excerpt: A sophisticated but informal setting with all the warmth and comfort of a traditional Irish pub.

verified_facts.text: The Garden Bar has a dedicated vegetarian and vegan menu.
verified_facts.excerpt: a dedicated vegetarian and vegan menu

verified_facts.text: The Whiskey Room, within The Garden Bar, showcases a collection of whiskeys from Ireland and beyond.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tucked away within The Garden Bar, The Whiskey Room offers an intimate setting showcasing a rare and remarkable collection of whiskeys from Ireland and beyond.

verified_facts.text: Guests can book a personalised whiskey tasting guided by the hotel team.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enhance your experience with a personalised whiskey tasting, guided by our expert team.

verified_facts.text: The Terrace has an indoor heated sunroom that opens up, plus an outdoor area with views across the garden.
verified_facts.excerpt: The indoor heated sunroom opens up to let the outdoors in, while the outdoor area features spacious dining tables, comfortable deck seating, and views across the garden.

verified_facts.text: The Spa has eight private treatment suites.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Spa offers eight private treatment suites

verified_facts.text: The Spa has a stone caldarium and a relaxation room.
verified_facts.excerpt: our specially designed stone caldarium and our restful relaxation room

verified_facts.text: The Spa's relaxation area has a panoramic saltwater aquarium.
verified_facts.excerpt: let your mind drift along with the spectacularly coloured fish in our panoramic saltwater aquarium.

verified_facts.text: Hydrotherapy facilities include a sauna, steam room, bubble pool and outside hot tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Move between the hydrotherapy spaces of our sauna, steam room, bubble pool and outside hot tub.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a heated indoor pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take slow, meditive laps in our heated 20 metre indoor pool.

verified_facts.text: The Spa collaborates with the British skincare brand Elemis.
verified_facts.excerpt: We are proud to collaborate with **Elemis**, the pioneering British skincare brand

verified_facts.text: The Spa is closed on Tuesdays.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Spa welcomes guests from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM, and is closed on Tuesdays.

verified_facts.text: Guests must be 18 or older to receive spa treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: guests must be 18 years or older to receive treatments.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre has a Peloton bike.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Peloton bike offers a range of benefits

verified_facts.text: Personal trainers offer bespoke running experiences through Killarney National Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: a bespoke running experience through the breathtaking beauty of Killarney National Park, our expert Personal Trainers are here to elevate your fitness journey.

verified_facts.text: For golfers the hotel offers early breakfasts, packed lunches, secure golf club storage and a drying room for clubs, shoes and clothing.
verified_facts.excerpt: we offer early breakfasts, packed lunches, secure golf club storage, and a purpose-built drying room that gently circulates warm air to dry your clubs, shoes, and clothing overnight

verified_facts.text: The concierge cannot book tee times; guests contact each golf club directly.
verified_facts.excerpt: We kindly ask that you contact each golf club directly to reserve your tee times.
